mapper.select: SELECT card_type, headline, body, cta_label, cta_path, source_digest, fallback, generated_at FROM home_insight WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND expires_at > NOW()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO home_insight (member_id, card_type, headline, body, cta_label, cta_path, source_digest, fallback, generated_at, expires_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{cardType}, #{headline}, #{body}, #{ctaLabel}, #{ctaPath}, #{sourceDigest}, #{fallback}, NOW(), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL #{ttlHours} HOUR)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE headline = VALUES(headline), body = VALUES(body), cta_label = VALUES(cta_label), cta_path = VALUES(cta_path), source_digest = VALUES(source_digest), fallback = VALUES(fallback), generated_at = VALUES(generated_at), expires_at = VALUES(expires_at)
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM member m JOIN pet p ON p.member_id = m.member_id AND p.is_active = 1 WHERE m.is_active = 1 ORDER BY m.member_id
